chunks: And in another narration from al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) that he said:
Certainly, the Messenger of Allah (Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family) said: Indeed, charity is not permissible for a wealthy person - and he did not say: nor for one of even creation -.

key_terms.ذِي مَرَّةٍ سَوِيٍّ: One of even creation / A person of equal standing

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on giving charity to a wealthy person according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the Prophet’s prohibition of charity for the wealthy is a specific legal ruling, explicitly noting the absence of the phrase 'nor for one of even creation' (dhī marrah sawiyy) in the original report. This textual precision distinguishes the general category of the rich from other potential exclusions, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on exact wording (lafz) in deriving fiqh. The narration underscores that while the wealthy are generally exempt from receiving sadaqah, the specific linguistic exclusion highlights the careful delineation of eligibility criteria in hadith transmission.
